entries.text: Started the week with a 5-mile sunrise trail run through the ridge trail. The crisp autumn air felt amazing, and I wrapped up the morning with a pour-over coffee while reviewing quarterly goals.

entries.text: Spent the afternoon at the downtown public library deep-working on system architecture. Tried the local bakery's cardamom buns afterwards — easily a 10/10.
entries.image: data:image/svg+xml;utf8,<svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' width='600' height='450' viewBox='0 0 600 450'><rect width='600' height='450' fill='%2368d391'/><rect x='80' y='60' width='440' height='300' rx='16' fill='%232f855a'/><line x1='120' y1='120' x2='480' y2='120' stroke='%23e2e8f0' stroke-width='12' stroke-linecap='round'/><line x1='120' y1='170' x2='400' y2='170' stroke='%23e2e8f0' stroke-width='12' stroke-linecap='round'/><line x1='120' y1='220' x2='450' y2='220' stroke='%23e2e8f0' stroke-width='12' stroke-linecap='round'/><text x='50%25' y='88%25' dominant-baseline='middle' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='24' fill='%23ffffff' font-weight='bold'>Tuesday: Library & Cardamom Buns</text></svg>

entries.text: Mid-week milestone: shipped the v1 prototype of the data pipeline! Team celebrated over hot ramen during an evening thunderstorm.
entries.image: data:image/svg+xml;utf8,<svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' width='600' height='450' viewBox='0 0 600 450'><rect width='600' height='450' fill='%2363b3ed'/><circle cx='300' cy='200' r='120' fill='%232b6cb0'/><path d='M220 200 Q300 320 380 200 Z' fill='%23c53030'/><circle cx='280' cy='190' r='20' fill='%23ecc94b'/><text x='50%25' y='88%25' dominant-baseline='middle' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='24' fill='%23ffffff' font-weight='bold'>Wednesday: Milestone Ramen</text></svg>

entries.text: Quiet garden day. Harvested heirloom cherry tomatoes and prepared fresh basil pesto from scratch. The smell in the kitchen was pure bliss.
entries.image: data:image/svg+xml;utf8,<svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' width='600' height='450' viewBox='0 0 600 450'><rect width='600' height='450' fill='%23f6e05e'/><circle cx='260' cy='210' r='50' fill='%23e53e3e'/><circle cx='340' cy='230' r='45' fill='%23dd6b20'/><circle cx='300' cy='160' r='40' fill='%23e53e3e'/><path d='M290 120 Q300 90 310 120' stroke='%2338a169' stroke-width='8' fill='none'/><text x='50%25' y='88%25' dominant-baseline='middle' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='24' fill='%232d3748' font-weight='bold'>Thursday: Heirloom Tomato Harvest</text></svg>

entries.text: Friday movie night under the backyard string lights. Watched an old classic with popcorn and spiced apple cider as the temperatures dropped.
entries.image: data:image/svg+xml;utf8,<svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' width='600' height='450' viewBox='0 0 600 450'><rect width='600' height='450' fill='%234a5568'/><rect x='100' y='80' width='400' height='220' rx='10' fill='%231a202c'/><circle cx='160' cy='60' r='10' fill='%23ecc94b'/><circle cx='250' cy='50' r='10' fill='%23ecc94b'/><circle cx='350' cy='55' r='10' fill='%23ecc94b'/><circle cx='440' cy='60' r='10' fill='%23ecc94b'/><text x='50%25' y='88%25' dominant-baseline='middle' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='24' fill='%23ffffff' font-weight='bold'>Friday: Backyard Movie Night</text></svg>

entries.text: Road trip up to the lake overlook. The autumn foliage is turning vibrant reds and golds. Sketched by the lakeshore for nearly two hours.
entries.image: data:image/svg+xml;utf8,<svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' width='600' height='450' viewBox='0 0 600 450'><rect width='600' height='450' fill='%239b2c2c'/><rect x='0' y='280' width='600' height='170' fill='%233182ce'/><polygon points='150,120 70,280 230,280' fill='%23dd6b20'/><polygon points='300,100 200,280 400,280' fill='%23d69e2e'/><polygon points='450,130 380,280 520,280' fill='%23c53030'/><text x='50%25' y='88%25' dominant-baseline='middle' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='24' fill='%23ffffff' font-weight='bold'>Saturday: Lake Foliage</text></svg>

entries.text: Sunday reset: planned the upcoming week, baked fresh sourdough loaves, and sent off this weekly reflection email to the family vault!
